selection: not selected; no useful gain in one valid six-turn pair
scope: Rough opaque nonmetal nonemissive primary surfaces only, hands excluded; only the specular-albedo guide changes. No altered ray budget, HDR lighting, normal/roughness guide or diffuse albedo. Fixed exposure2/cap144; 2560x1440 lossless YUV444 video,1334x750 ray input. No raw numerical readback, uncapped performance or material/outdoor candidate tests.

convergence.note:
Review post-turn convergence, using each shot's own settled image as a reference.

This is a transient-image difference proxy, not an absolute quality score.
Exposure is normalized within each wall crop. Torch, hands and HUD are excluded.
The motion end is estimated from captured frames, not ffmpeg startup time.
convergence.motion_end_method: strongest motion burst; at most two quiet frames; late-end guard

video-codec.note: Lossless mode preserves converted YUV samples; RGB-to-YUV conversion still rounds.
